assessment_method: Assess each complete later contribution and each independently meaningful changed component, including selection, omissions, grammar, arrangement and formula use. Old ingredients, word counts, similarity percentages and previous admissions do not decide these cases. The low originality threshold and the strongest contrary argument remain part of every qualified judgment.

cases.independent_contrary_argument_retained: Changing good to eternal, apostles to Supreme Pontiffs, adding the optional martyr identification and dropping the Son-vicar relation are real theological redaction, not spellings or factual name filling alone. The low originality threshold can protect deliberate selection and arrangement of otherwise conventional words. The exact whole target has no identical old witness; the new material might be viewed as sufficient authorship in its whole adaptation. This uncertainty is why the finding is moderate and qualified, not an unqualified public-domain identity or holder/court clearance.
cases.root_whole_expression_judgment: The full old flock/protection/shepherds prayer and its ordered relative clause remain. The divine epithet, finite named pontiffs and martyr option, removal of the vicar phrase and common short cue together constitute a routine application without a new petition or distinctive new wording. This is a moderate qualified assessment; its real theological redaction and the possibility of original cumulative editing remain explicit. The prior singular Common grants nothing here.

cases.independent_contrary_argument_retained: Retargeting a sacramental blessing from incense grains to a lighted candle changes its expressive ritual application, and selecting an old alternative verb can itself be deliberate editorial authorship. Old words are not a licence for a creative modern compilation. The exact whole old witness lacks cereum, and neither older intende witness equals the target whole prayer. The low originality threshold makes this a qualified judgment.
cases.root_whole_expression_judgment: The complete old outpouring/light/protection prayer and printed ending remain in order. The changed object and agreement are substantive ritual reapplication, while the intensification verb is independently old in whole variants. Together they specify an ordinary object and request inside the inherited composition, without a new literary sequence. Treat this as qualified, not as old whole-word identity; keep the variant whole witnesses intact.

cases.independent_contrary_argument_retained: Widening the material beyond palm and olive and presenting a parenthesized alternative is intentional modern ritual editing. A short contribution can satisfy the low originality threshold, and the older category wording is not lexically identical to the added phrase. Source age and a shared plant category alone would not authorize a genuinely rewritten prayer.
cases.root_whole_expression_judgment: The full old prayer already connects branches, bodily veneration, spiritual devotion, victory and mercy. The ordinary other-trees alternative, same-meaning grammatical gender, parentheses and independently complete old closing formula introduce no sufficiently original new composition together. The wider material class is an actual later change, not a spelling or an exact old lexical donor; the judgment is qualified.

cases.independent_contrary_argument_retained: Modern performance redaction can be creative selection or arrangement even where every lyric ingredient is old. Assigning both choirs in sectionI, uniform choir1 verses/choir2 refrains inII, splitting the Psalm inIII and giving numeric hymn roles inIV changes the inherited performance plan. Electam is an actual descriptive addition. The full opening explanatory sentence is newly worded prose, not merely numerals, and a new mandatory-doxology instruction is not in the inspected old pages. Functional writing can retain protectable wording, and the low originality threshold means that the cumulative contribution cannot be cleared by a one-sung-word count or by calling all instructions facts. No older exact version of the whole modern arrangement is claimed.
cases.root_whole_expression_judgment: The old continuous four-section sequence already determines all sung sections, complete hymn stanzas, doxology and the same prescribed response repetitions. Assess the modern choir partition, numerical explanation, mandatory-doxology instruction and electam together: the role plan is a routine functional allocation, its explanatory prose states that numbering directly, and the adjective stays inside the inherited vine clause. No sufficiently original literary or musical arrangement is found in this exact bounded transcription. Preserve the genuine performance-redaction objection; no score, melody, engraving or unmeasured ceremony is admitted.

cases.independent_contrary_argument_retained: A new compilation or liturgical arrangement can be original even with public-domain ingredients. Choosing these office antiphons for Eucharistic transfer, removing intervening Psalms, omitting an acclamation and making a three-paragraph set may be deliberate selection and recontextualization. An exactprefix is not proof of an old whole-antiphon length, and the oldCrossoffice is not the modernFridayarrangement. Oldwords alone would not clear a creative cento or newly authored ritual.
cases.root_whole_expression_judgment: Each complete expression is independently old; the historical office already selects all three in the same order. The second selected expression is an explicitly bounded contiguous prefix with its old Alleluia retained in source evidence. Presenting the ordered antiphons without intervening Psalms, and assigning a transfer use, adds no new prayer wording or sufficiently creative selection. This uses the ordinary PD route, with its narrow arrangement reasoning retained; it proves no old Good Friday transfer rite or seasonal deletion rule.
target: Antiphons at the Translation of the Blessed Sacrament

cases.independent_contrary_argument_retained: A modern Latin translation of a public-domain Hebrew text can itself be original protected expression. Translation choices need only minimal creativity, and the revised Psalm component must be assessed on its own as well as inside the complete Introit: it cannot be diluted by the length of the inherited Gaudeamus. The choice of a present effusion and song instead of a perfect eructation and works is an expressive literary/translation decision, not an unavoidable inflection. No older exact Psalm witness or1945 rights clearance is supplied. Modern selection of this reading for a Queenship Introit could also be characterized as deliberate adaptation. A simple percent-match, short-word count or prior sixteen-case authority would not answer this objection.
cases.root_whole_expression_judgment: Assess the changed Psalm clause independently rather than diluting it in the Introit. Its ordinary verb and song/works replacements preserve the same inherited clause, subject, image and succession; the Queen title and conditional acclamation are conventional. Taken together there is a defensible qualified minimal-expression basis for this exact component and whole body. A modern translation can be original, and these are actual translation choices: no finding that the1945 Psalter or other verses are free follows.

cases.independent_contrary_argument_retained: The target deliberately selects an invocation from one oldsource, discards the different six-word opening of another oldhymnstanza, joins its remaining protection/deathpetition to a Queen-of-mercyhead and frames the result as Alleluia. Compilation or adaptation can be original even where allwords are old and short. The change from Mother-of-grace/sweet-parent-of-clemency to Hail-Queen-of-mercy is genuine title/address redaction, not wordidentity. Neitheroldsource proves the completejoinedarrangement, and lowcreativitythreshold means ingredientPD alone cannot settle it.
cases.root_whole_expression_judgment: The complete old stanza already contains the invocation followed by the same two contiguous protection/death petitions in the same order. Substituting the separately old commonplace Queen-of-mercy greeting and conventional Alleluia frame preserves that whole architecture without a new image or argument. The joined modern arrangement is not itself an old exact witness; its deliberate title/address redaction remains the contrary argument. This is one qualified body, not a general cento permission.
